title: Converting Units of Time and Elapsed Time
seo_title: Grade 4 Time and Elapsed Time Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 4)
standard_text: Convert time measures from smaller to larger units, and vice versa: seconds to minutes, minutes to hours, hours to days, days to weeks, weeks to months, and months to years; solve problems involving conversion of units of length, mass, capacity, and time, including problems involving elapsed time in hours and minutes.
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 time worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: convert seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months and years, and elapsed time with a.m. and p.m. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: 1 hour = 60 minutes; count on hours, then minutes.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 1 minute = 60 seconds, 1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 day = 24 hours, 1 week = 7 days, 1 year = 12 months.
  • From a bigger unit to a smaller one, multiply; from a smaller unit to a bigger one, divide.
  • Elapsed time is how much time passes. Count on in hours, then in minutes.
  • Use a.m. for times from midnight to noon and p.m. for times from noon to midnight.

Examples

Example

Start 9:40 a.m., 2 hours 35 minutes

9:40 + 2 hours = 11:40

11:40 + 35 minutes = 12:15

Answer: 12:15 p.m.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
100 minutes in an hourAn hour has 60 minutes.
Counting from the wrong timeStart at the start time.
Not regrouping 60 minutes75 minutes is 1 hour 15 minutes.

faq.q: What does MATATAG Math 4 ask about time?
faq.a: Convert time measures from smaller to larger units and vice versa (seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years), and solve problems involving conversion of units, including elapsed time in hours and minutes.

faq.q: How many weeks are in a month?
faq.a: About 4 weeks; most months have a few days more.

faq.q: How do I find elapsed time across noon?
faq.a: Count to 12:00 first, then count on.

items.q: Convert. 720 seconds = ☐ minutes
items.e: 60 seconds = 1 minute, so 720 ÷ 60 = 12 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 11 weeks = ☐ days
items.e: 1 week = 7 days, so 11 × 7 = 77 days.

items.q: Convert. 540 seconds = ☐ minutes
items.e: 60 seconds = 1 minute, so 540 ÷ 60 = 9 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 8 weeks = ☐ days
items.e: 1 week = 7 days, so 8 × 7 = 56 days.

items.q: Convert. 19 months = ☐ weeks (Use 1 month = 4 weeks.)
items.e: 1 month = 4 weeks, so 19 × 4 = 76 weeks.

items.q: Convert. 480 minutes = ☐ hours
items.e: 60 minutes = 1 hour, so 480 ÷ 60 = 8 hours.

items.q: Convert. 2 hours = ☐ minutes
items.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes, so 2 × 60 = 120 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 11 hours = ☐ minutes
items.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes, so 11 × 60 = 660 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 119 days = ☐ weeks
items.e: 7 days = 1 week, so 119 ÷ 7 = 17 weeks.

items.q: Convert. 8 hours = ☐ minutes
items.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes, so 8 × 60 = 480 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 4 minutes = ☐ seconds
items.e: 1 minute = 60 seconds, so 4 × 60 = 240 seconds.

items.q: Convert. 16 years = ☐ months
items.e: 1 year = 12 months, so 16 × 12 = 192 months.

items.q: Convert. 5 months = ☐ weeks (Use 1 month = 4 weeks.)
items.e: 1 month = 4 weeks, so 5 × 4 = 20 weeks.

items.q: Convert. 7 weeks = ☐ days
items.e: 1 week = 7 days, so 7 × 7 = 49 days.

items.q: Convert. 360 seconds = ☐ minutes
items.e: 60 seconds = 1 minute, so 360 ÷ 60 = 6 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 8 weeks = ☐ months (Use 1 month = 4 weeks.)
items.e: 4 weeks = 1 month, so 8 ÷ 4 = 2 months.

items.q: Convert. 288 hours = ☐ days
items.e: 24 hours = 1 day, so 288 ÷ 24 = 12 days.

items.q: Convert. 192 hours = ☐ days
items.e: 24 hours = 1 day, so 192 ÷ 24 = 8 days.

items.q: Convert. 14 months = ☐ weeks (Use 1 month = 4 weeks.)
items.e: 1 month = 4 weeks, so 14 × 4 = 56 weeks.

items.q: Convert. 12 years = ☐ months
items.e: 1 year = 12 months, so 12 × 12 = 144 months.

items.q: Convert. 3 hours = ☐ minutes
items.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes (not 100). Multiply: 3 × 60 = 180, so 3 hours = 180 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 4 minutes = ☐ seconds
items.e: 1 minute = 60 seconds. Multiply: 4 × 60 = 240, so 4 minutes = 240 seconds.

items.q: Convert. 9 minutes = ☐ seconds
items.e: 1 minute = 60 seconds. Multiply: 9 × 60 = 540, so 9 minutes = 540 seconds.

items.q: Convert. 300 seconds = ☐ minutes
items.e: 1 minute = 60 seconds. Seconds to minutes: divide. 300 ÷ 60 = 5, because 5 × 60 = 300.

items.q: Convert. 240 minutes = ☐ hours
items.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes. Minutes to hours: divide. 240 ÷ 60 = 4, because 4 × 60 = 240. 2 hours 40 minutes would mean 1 hour = 100 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 3 years = ☐ months
items.e: 1 year = 12 months. Multiply: 3 × 12 = 36, so 3 years = 36 months.

items.q: Convert. 60 months = ☐ years
items.e: 1 year = 12 months. Months to years: divide. 60 ÷ 12 = 5, because 5 × 12 = 60.

items.q: Convert. 5 weeks = ☐ days
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. Multiply: 5 × 7 = 35, so 5 weeks = 35 days.

items.q: Convert. 28 days = ☐ weeks
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. Days to weeks: divide. 28 ÷ 7 = 4, so 28 days = 4 weeks.

items.q: Convert. 2 days = ☐ hours
items.e: 1 day = 24 hours. Multiply: 2 × 24 = 48, so 2 days = 48 hours.

items.q: How many days are in 1 year (not a leap year)?
items.e: A year has 365 days. A leap year has one extra day, 29 February, so it has 366 days. 52 is the number of weeks in a year.

items.q: About how many weeks are in 1 year?
items.e: A year has 365 days. 365 ÷ 7 is 52 with 1 day left over, so a year is about 52 weeks. 12 is the number of months.

items.q: Convert. 2 hours 15 minutes = ☐ minutes
items.e: 2 hours = 2 × 60 = 120 minutes. Add the 15 minutes: 120 + 15 = 135 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 1 hour 40 minutes = ☐ minutes
items.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes. Add the 40 minutes: 60 + 40 = 100 minutes. 140 would mean 1 hour = 100 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 3 minutes 20 seconds = ☐ seconds
items.e: 3 minutes = 3 × 60 = 180 seconds. Add the 20 seconds: 180 + 20 = 200 seconds.

items.q: Convert. 2 years 5 months = ☐ months
items.e: 2 years = 2 × 12 = 24 months. Add the 5 months: 24 + 5 = 29 months.

items.q: Convert. 3 weeks 2 days = ☐ days
items.e: 3 weeks = 3 × 7 = 21 days. Add the 2 days: 21 + 2 = 23 days.

items.q: Which is the same as 150 minutes?
items.e: 120 minutes = 2 hours. 150 − 120 = 30, so 150 minutes = 2 hours 30 minutes. 1 hour 50 minutes would mean 1 hour = 100 minutes.

items.q: Which is the same as 100 seconds?
items.e: 1 minute = 60 seconds (not 100). 100 − 60 = 40, so 100 seconds = 1 minute 40 seconds.

items.q: Which is the same as 30 months?
items.e: 1 year = 12 months, so 2 years = 24 months. 30 − 24 = 6, so 30 months = 2 years 6 months. 3 years would mean 1 year = 10 months.

items.q: How much time passes from 7:30 to 7:55?
items.e: Count on from 7:30 to 7:55: 55 − 30 = 25 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 9:10 to 9:20?
items.e: Count on from 9:10 to 9:20: 20 − 10 = 10 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 4:05 to 4:15?
items.e: Count on from 4:05 to 4:15: 15 − 5 = 10 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 3:15 to 3:40?
items.e: Count on from 3:15 to 3:40: 40 − 15 = 25 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 7:15 to 7:40?
items.e: Count on from 7:15 to 7:40: 40 − 15 = 25 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 10:25 to 10:50?
items.e: Count on from 10:25 to 10:50: 50 − 25 = 25 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 1:33 to 2:27?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 1:33 to 2:00 is 27 minutes. Then 2:00 to 2:27 is 27 minutes. 27 + 27 = 54 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 9:30 to 10:22?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 9:30 to 10:00 is 30 minutes. Then 10:00 to 10:22 is 22 minutes. 30 + 22 = 52 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 8:49 to 9:18?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 8:49 to 9:00 is 11 minutes. Then 9:00 to 9:18 is 18 minutes. 11 + 18 = 29 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 5:30 to 6:15?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 5:30 to 6:00 is 30 minutes. Then 6:00 to 6:15 is 15 minutes. 30 + 15 = 45 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 5:57 to 6:45?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 5:57 to 6:00 is 3 minutes. Then 6:00 to 6:45 is 45 minutes. 3 + 45 = 48 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 7:30 to 8:20?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 7:30 to 8:00 is 30 minutes. Then 8:00 to 8:20 is 20 minutes. 30 + 20 = 50 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 7:39 to 8:14?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 7:39 to 8:00 is 21 minutes. Then 8:00 to 8:14 is 14 minutes. 21 + 14 = 35 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 3:40 to 4:20?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 3:40 to 4:00 is 20 minutes. Then 4:00 to 4:20 is 20 minutes. 20 + 20 = 40 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 8:23 to 9:11?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 8:23 to 9:00 is 37 minutes. Then 9:00 to 9:11 is 11 minutes. 37 + 11 = 48 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 8:50 to 9:17?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 8:50 to 9:00 is 10 minutes. Then 9:00 to 9:17 is 17 minutes. 10 + 17 = 27 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 2:10 to 3:25?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 2:10 to 3:00 is 50 minutes. Then 3:00 to 3:25 is 25 minutes. 50 + 25 = 1 hour 15 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 8:50 to 10:00?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 8:50 to 9:00 is 10 minutes. Then 9:00 to 10:00 is 60 minutes. 10 + 60 = 1 hour 10 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 6:05 to 7:10?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 6:05 to 7:00 is 55 minutes. Then 7:00 to 7:10 is 10 minutes. 55 + 10 = 1 hour 5 minutes.

items.q: How much time passes from 1:55 to 3:15?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 1:55 to 2:00 is 5 minutes. Then 2:00 to 3:15 is 75 minutes. 5 + 75 = 1 hour 20 minutes.

items.q: A basketball game starts at 8:15 a.m. and ends at 12:00 p.m. How long does the game last?
items.e: From 8:15 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. is 3 hours 45 minutes.

items.q: A cake goes in the oven at 9:50 a.m. and bakes for 45 minutes. What time is it done?
items.e: From 9:50 a.m., count on 45 minutes: 10:35 a.m.

Angelo starts cleaning the room at 10:55 a.m. and cleans for 25 minutes. What time does Angelo finish cleaning?

items.q: Maria finished a swim lesson at 3:00 p.m. It took 40 minutes. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back 40 minutes from 3:00 p.m.: 2:20 p.m.

items.q: Ivan finished a math test at 7:35 p.m. It took 55 minutes. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back in two jumps: 7:35 p.m. − 35 minutes = 7:00 p.m. Then go back the other 20 minutes: 6:40 p.m.

items.q: Hazel finished a game at 3:30 p.m. It took 25 minutes. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back 25 minutes from 3:30 p.m.: 3:05 p.m.

items.q: Sheila finished a walk at 6:20 p.m. It took 40 minutes. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back in two jumps: 6:20 p.m. − 20 minutes = 6:00 p.m. Then go back the other 20 minutes: 5:40 p.m.

items.q: Ivan finished a show at 7:50 p.m. It took 40 minutes. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back 40 minutes from 7:50 p.m.: 7:10 p.m.

items.q: Maria finished a class trip at 3:40 p.m. It took 1 hour 10 minutes. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back in two jumps: 3:40 p.m. − 40 minutes = 3:00 p.m. Then go back the other 30 minutes: 2:30 p.m.

items.q: Christian got to the park at 9:40 p.m. and left at 10:25 p.m. How long was Christian there?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 9:40 to 10:00 is 20 minutes. Then 10:00 to 10:25 is 25 minutes. 20 + 25 = 45 minutes.

items.q: Jomar got to the library at 3:50 p.m. and left at 4:25 p.m. How long was Jomar there?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 3:50 to 4:00 is 10 minutes. Then 4:00 to 4:25 is 25 minutes. 10 + 25 = 35 minutes.

items.q: Gabriel got to the museum at 6:45 p.m. and left at 7:25 p.m. How long was Gabriel there?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 6:45 to 7:00 is 15 minutes. Then 7:00 to 7:25 is 25 minutes. 15 + 25 = 40 minutes.

items.q: Nico got to swim practice at 3:50 p.m. and left at 4:30 p.m. How long was Nico there?
items.e: Jump to the next hour first: 3:50 to 4:00 is 10 minutes. Then 4:00 to 4:30 is 30 minutes. 10 + 30 = 40 minutes.
